definitions.explanation: The final part or extremity of something.
What will happen eventually; the outcome after a process.
The final part of a time period (month, year, etc.).

examples.japanese: ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{末|すえ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit by the end of the month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ}、⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After a long discussion, a conclusion was reached.

examples.japanese: ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧。
examples.english: It's cold down to my fingertips.
Small flowers are blooming at the tip of the branch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子孫|しそん}→子孫：00372_shison⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{語|かた}り→語る：01930_kataru⟧⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧⟦べき→べき：10016_beki⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a story that should be passed down to future generations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つかんだ→掴む：02290_tsukamu⟧。
examples.english: After much hardship, they achieved success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悩|なや}んだ→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧{末|すえ}、⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決意|けつい}した→決意する：28116_ketsuisuru⟧。
examples.english: After much deliberation, I decided to change jobs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The end of the year gets busy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧{末|すえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: The contract expires at the end of this month.

notes:
{末|すえ} indicates the end or conclusion of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ}（⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧） (after..., at the end of...)
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{末|すえ} (end of the month)
- ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧{末|すえ} (end of the year)
- ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧{末|すえ} (weekend) - note: pronounced まつ in this compound

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ} (in the future, eventually)
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ} (after much hardship)
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ} (after discussion)

PRONUNCIATION:
- {末|すえ}: kun'yomi, used independently or in patterns like ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ}
- {末|まつ}: on'yomi, used in compounds like ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧, ⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧
